name: sortable-list
title: Sortable list
description: A list you reorder by dragging a row's grip, or from the keyboard: Space lifts the row, the arrows carry it, Space drops it and Escape puts it back, while a live region reads out each new position. The other rows reflow with a spring; an optional round × removes a row.
author: UI Stacks <https://uistacks.dev>, MIT; free component, unchanged
